description:
Beautiful townhome in the iconic West End area! So close to everything. The highways are 1 minute away! Enjoy the shopping, cafes, eating that West End has to offer! Check out the parthenon! 6 minutes to downtown! 4 minutes to midtown!

Our "Movie Nights" themed townhome is perfect to feel at home in. Whether you're just stopping through, enjoying the city or having a night in, this cozy space is a great place to relax.

The space
The living room has a twin bed and two fold down futons. The 40 in Roku TV or the pull down screen and projector are perfect ways to catch up on your favorite movies or shows!

The dining area seats 4 and has a great view of the screens. A half bath to the side.

Enjoy the full kitchen, just like home!

Upstairs there are two queen bedrooms, both with ensuite baths.
